ambient: Someone leans on you, briefly, and goes away.
The light moves along your length by a whole hour.
A slat two along from you settles, and you feel it as your own.
description: You are a garden fence. This is not a metaphor and it is not funny. You have been a fence for a very long time, in a garden, in an afternoon, and you have the whole history of the paint on you.
name: The Fence

looks: Four coats. You remember every one being applied.
Blistered on the south side, which is your south side.
Somebody chose this colour and you were there for the conversation.
objects.name: the paint

looks: Ordinary. Somebody keeps it. You hold one edge of it.
A ball came over once. You remember the ball.
It is the same afternoon it has always been.
objects.name: the garden

weather: It is the same warm afternoon it has always been, and it is going to stay that way.
